subject.title: fix(media): accept repeated content-length when values match

question: Should OpenClaw accept repeated matching Content-Length handling in the exported media-core parser used by media and plugin SDK consumers?
rationale: The implementation matches the HTTP contract and appears correct, but repository policy treats exported plugin/media helper semantics as compatibility-sensitive even when the change broadens acceptance.

options.title: Accept exported parser behavior
options.body: Land the PR with the shared helper accepting matching repeated values while preserving malformed, unsafe, empty, and conflicting rejection behavior.

options.title: Narrow to internal callers
options.body: Ask for a smaller design that keeps exported parser behavior strict and handles repeated matching values only at selected internal fetch boundaries.

recommendation.title: Accept exported parser behavior
recommendation.body: Land the PR with the shared helper accepting matching repeated values while preserving malformed, unsafe, empty, and conflicting rejection behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest current path history for both the shared media parser and the plugin SDK media runtime boundary.
